method: Within each signal year, rank every dimension into five equal-frequency groups in its expected direction. Compare the expected-best quintile with the expected-worst quintile and inspect the complete quintile path.
constraints: Use only 2016-2022 opportunities and signal-time features; future paths are labels only.
Do not choose cutoffs, combine dimensions, weight scores or create a trading strategy from this audit.
Future up, sideways and down market outcomes are attribution only, never applicability filters.
A failed dimension is stopped without trying alternate windows or transformations.
